skills.description: Using fixed cameras on a hydroponic growing rack to capture high-resolution images of plant roots (in transparent containers) and leaves (young and old), AI vision analysis identifies root color (white = healthy, yellow = early stress, brown = severe stress, black = rotting) and leaf morphology (tip burn, leaf-margin scorch, yellowing, curling) to judge whether the nutrient solution is too concentrated or too dilute, and outputs adjustment advice (dilute with fresh water or add concentrated nutrient solution). This skill lets hydroponic growers quickly assess nutrient solution status without an EC meter. Application scenarios: hydroponic growing racks, home hydroponic vegetables, plant factories, research hydroponic systems. Skill features: hydroponic beginners often suffer from burnt seedlings or nutrient deficiency due to wrong nutrient concentration.
